system.description:
• Effect: Your patron's powers share one pool of favour: 1 use a day at 1st level, 2 at 4th and 3 at 8th. Spend a use on any Dark Gift, Patron's Mark or Patron Feature you have unlocked that costs Patron Favour; a power that is always on or passive costs nothing.
  • Any Warlock may spend 1 Patron Favour as part of casting Eldritch Blast: the target makes its save against one blast with Disadvantage.
  • Unless it says otherwise, a patron power takes your action.
  • The Pact Deepens: from 13th level a patron power that deals damage rolls half as many dice again (round down), and from 17th twice as many.
  • When you spend your last Patron Favour of the day, the GM may name a small service your patron expects before it returns.
